ResearchProjectDef.label: Terratech Essentials
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to properly create and grow the fundamentals of terratech, such as terramass - a growable building material - and Terraseeds, specialized seeds that are used to grow biotic gear and equipment. Teaches you how to nurture a Terraforge channeling seed, which can be shaped at a crafting spot. Terraseeds are believed to be divine gifts to the tribes of the galaxy; therefore, it's knowledge is both sacred, and closely guarded by the local Terratech faction.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: You can now grow a Terraforge, which is your primary method of acquiring and producing most Terratech organic creations. Shape the Terraforge seed at a normal crafting spot, then plant the seed in any desired spot. Once the Terraforge has grown, you can shape any new seeds at it.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Terrathyst Essentials
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to properly create and grow Terrathyst; a crystal that forms an ever-strengthening lattice the more of it that is present, making it a infinitely usable material in terms of viability. Teaches you how to grow a terrathyst cultivator, which then grows numerous smaller crystals that can be harvested or shattered for terrathyst. The cultivator grows the smaller crystals year-round, and requires little interaction once grown. Being engineered like organic terratech, terrathyst doesn't require fertility or light. It does, however, require water, mud, or sap-enriched terrains to grow in. Terrathyst is just one more outlet of tapping into nature, as nature is not only verdant plants and trees, but also the earth, elements, and even the cosmos. Therefore, it is just as useable as plants, and have it's own unique upsides and downsides, which tribes might prefer over organic matter. Terrathyst production takes lightly longer than organic production, due to their sensitivity, being a liquid-grown product, and the need for many shards. However, their ease of understanding and shaping is just as simple as Prima creations, and terrathyst serves as the dominant material.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: You can now create growths of terrathyst, which is your primary method of creating crystal-based structures and weapons. These are easy to grow, but can only be grown at a sap bay. Shocksap bays are recommended, but glowsap bays can grow these as well.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Prima Terraseed Cultivation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to nuture and handle Prima Terraseeds, alongside growing the pods that produce them. Prima weapons are fast to grow and easy to handle, but are limited in their damage, and wither away relatively quickly.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: Prima Weapons are quick and simple to grow compared to other Terraweapons. You can grow the pods in any normal field or Glowsap Bay, and once ready they will produce a random weapon. Like nearly every other Terraweapons, Prima weapons have a limited lifespan once they are harvested. After this lifespan runs out, they wither away and will need to be replaced!\n\nYou can learn to grow specific Prima weapons via the "Weapon Focusing" researches.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Prima Focusing: Melee Weapons
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to grow terrapods that specifically grow patterns based off melee weapons.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Prima Focusing: Light Weapons
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to grow terrapods that specifically produce light, quickly grown Prima weapons.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Prima Focusing: Standard Weapons
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to grow terrapods that specifically grow standard, well-rounded Prima weapons.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Prima Focusing: Heavy Weapons
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to grow terrapods that specifically grow powerful, role-oriented Prima weapons.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Prima Sentry Seeds
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to properly grow and plant specialized seeds which will instantly sprout into biotic plant patterns akin to small turrets. The nature of these plants - labelled as "Sentries" - requires them to be placed in soil that can grow plants. Instead of using electricity or requiring fuel, these sentries have a limited lifespan, which drains over time and whenever they generate projectiles. The seeds these sentries come from are acquired directly from Primwood Sentinels, and matured, unmodified Terraweapons.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Periwood Terraseed Cultivation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to nuture and handle Periwood Terraseeds, which grow into Pericore Trees. The core of these trees can be harvested, which are then carefully carved into periwood weapons.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: Periwood Weapons are considered the 'staple' terraweapon type due to their low requirements, sap potential, and accuracy. They are grown by planting a Periwood Terratree in fertile soil, and then carving the weapon out when it's fully grown. Periwood weapons have a limited lifespan once they are harvested, but this base lifespan is significantly longer than nearly every other lifespan. Additionally, saps are much more effective in Periwood weapons than any other genome. \n\nUnlike Prima weapons, specific periwood weapons cannot be focused. However, the chance of getting any weapon is equal.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Periwood Carving
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to carve periwood hearts into various weapons. Due to the smaller amount of periwood weapons, all the carving techniques can be learned at once.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Periwood Groveguard Seeds
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to properly grow and plant specialized seeds which will shortly sprout into a biotic turret that's effective at defense and supression. Like other biotic turrets, the Groveguard has a limited lifespan, which drains over time and whenever they generate projectiles. However, this loss is slower than Prima turrets. Groveguard seeds require understanding of pressurized projectiles, which is protected knowledge. You will need to study the tome that gives this knowledge.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Primwood Conduit Seeds
ResearchProjectDef.description: Not everything is hands-on; while you take care of the planet, the planet will take care of you back. This research enables you to create "Conduit" seeds, which - when planted - grow powerful trees that protect and supply your colony. \n\nThese seeds are shaped at the Terraforge, and take considerable time to finish. Stopping in the middle of creating a seed will require you to start all over again.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: Conduit Trees are special trees meant to assist and advance EcoTech tribes. Each tree provides a special, unique passive mechanic, such as providing special weapons, saps, and materials. Like any other seed, you can shape the seed of every tree at a Terraforge.\n\nYou can have multiples of the same tree available on the map, but be aware that each tree requires ample space from one of the same kind!

ResearchProjectDef.label: Elderwood Conduit Seeds
ResearchProjectDef.description: Discover how to shape more advanced conduit seeds consisting of Elderwood, allowing access to new, powerful conduit trees. \n\nThese seeds are shaped at the Terraforge, and take considerable time to finish. Stopping in the middle of creating a seed will require you to start all over again.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: Your research into more advanced conduit trees has allowed you to learn the creation of an entirely unique tree: \nReclaimer Trees, which recycle fabricated and electronic items into more usable materials. \nAll Primwood trees now also have a more effective Elderwood variant (see seed descriptions). Additionally, you can now properly handle and plant more exclusive seeds that are carried by the Terratech Curators.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Pattern 52R8898111-E
ResearchProjectDef.description: This research is obfuscated; experiments with seed shaping shows this will result in a new seed, but what it exactly grows into is not yet known. \n\n(Despite this research not being fully implemented, the research cost has been reduced by 90%. It will go back to it's intended amount of 1500 when fully implemented).
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: Your research into this tech has has gone as far as it can. One day, your colonists will put two and two together... but for now, it remains a mystery.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Glowsap Cultivation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to cultivate plants and trees that produce Glowsap, a crucial item that fuels many structures and processes. Dark mode included!

ResearchProjectDef.label: Simple Glowsap Bays
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to construct simple basins that utilize glowsap to sustain Terratech plants. Ideal for locations where fertile soil is scarce or entirely absent. Glowsap has enough nutrients to sustain many growths that have relatively simple patterns, but more complex ones require stronger or specific saps.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: Glowsap Bays are fillable structures that you can use to grow most EcoTech plants. While they cannot support normal plants, glowsap bays do enable you to make dedicated spaces for EcoTech plants, allowing normal soil to be used for everyday crops.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Brightsap Structures
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to further utilize Brightsap, and create various strutures that can compliment your base, while also providing decent amounts of light. \n\nThese seeds are shaped at the Terraforge, and take considerable time to finish. Stopping in the middle of creating a seed will require you to start all over again.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Terrasap Refinement
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to refine Glowsap into valuable terrasaps that can modify and strengthen Terraweapons, and learn how to break down more concentrated saps into usable ones.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: Glowsap may become abundant eventually, and refinement allows you to turn it into items that can be used to improve your weapons, or fuel various structures. After creating and planting the seed for a Sap Transposer, you can fill it with glowsap. A random refined sap will be produced a short time later.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Small Terravats
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to grow Terravats, which are crucial for delving deeper into Terratech as a whole. These ancient vats enable you to experiment, create, and modify Terratech creations of all types, including creations that are beyond the capabilities of the very planet. \n\nTerravats utilize large amounts of glowsap, and refined terrasaps. You will need access to both to properly utilize Terravats.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: Terravats are special structures that allow you to modify Terraweapons. You can insert various saps and weapons into the vat. When these combine together (which happens roughly every 15 days, starting from when the Terravat reached maturity), the two will fuse together and create a new variant!\n\nWeapons that can be infused will have a tag that says "Accepts any sap transplant", and you can check the description of each sap to see what modifications they produce. You can also check the Terravat description for a full guide on the Terravat mechanics as well.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Lore Entry: Psychic Weaponry
ResearchProjectDef.description: Records tell of a special, exclusive breed of Terraweapons that only the highest of societies and engineers know of. This research will provide additional information about this unique breed.... \n\nUpon researching, you will discover some information about possibilities known to exist, but not known to the Rimworld. This research currently doesn't grant anything; however, should it's contained knowledge ever come within reach, this information will help you achieve it quickly.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: You have discovered that Prima Terraweapons are just one of several known types of Terraseeds. This particular research has unveiled that one of the most powerful types are known as "Royal" Terraseeds, and are carefully engineered with the mysterious - and massive - power of Anima. Products of these seeds are documented to take up to years to grow, and properly growing them requires skill that only prodigies can achieve; however, any given Royal Terraweapon contains power that rivals - or even completely overshadows - Spacer tech that's widely believed to be superior. The secrets behind producing the weapons are currently lost and not known to any; however, records rumor that *very* few surviving Anima weapons may still be out there, perhaps within relative reach....

ResearchProjectDef.label: Lore Entry: Hyperdense Materials
ResearchProjectDef.description: Records tell of various materials that are entirely natural, but seem to have no presence on the planet. Even growth methods are undocumented, meaning this knowledge is either highly protected, or lost. \n\nUpon researching, you will discover some information about possibilities known to exist, but not known to the Rimworld. This research currently doesn't grant anything; however, should it's contained knowledge ever come within reach, this information will help you achieve it quickly.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: You have discovered that original Terratech tribe somehow were able to subject various materials to immense pressure, creating powerful, brand new materials with special traits. The history you pieced together tells of three: \nBiothite, an organic material that had both durability and utility. Research indicated it posessed some sort of regenerative factor, and was widely used to nuture or improve plant production. Stellite, which was said to harness the power of stars in a solid form. While this too was used to enhance plant growths, records mostly indicate it was essential for creating specialized weapons and structures that exploited the incredible speed of light. How light was compressed is another mystery entirely. Esperium, which was said to both defend again, and utilize, psychic energy. Research indicates esperium was most commonly used in defensive practices, but also had quality-of-life utility. Other materials - such as Tallorium, Prismium, and Genesite - are mentioned, but no information regarding them could be pieced together.
